messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: p95 and p99 latency SLO breach on service=embed-service, route=/generate (eu-west). p95=820ms (SLO 300ms), p99=2.3s. Traffic spike + sustained tail. Pager: PD incident #INC-6721 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-6721 triggered - on-call: alex_k (ack now)

alex_k: acked via PD. I'm on it. Quick note: last deploy was a canary of embed-service:v2-canary ~15m ago.

alex_k: grabbing grafana and logs now — metrics look like large tail for short requests, CPU on workers normal, but we have elevated KV cache miss rate. link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/EmbedLatency/embed-slo?orgId=1

cheng_w: adding context — we rolled tokenization change in v2 that pads sequences differently, could increase cache churn for short prompts. Noticed increased `kv_cache_evictions` on host group eu-west-2.

lee_ops: quick infra check: autoscaler didn't kick for canary group because minReplicas=1. There are 2 canary pods only. If they're suffering cold/eviction, tail will hit.

alex_k: running quick checks ->
```
kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=embed-service,canary=true
NAME                                READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
embed-service-canary-7d6f8c9d4-2qk8 1/1     Running   0          14m
embed-service-canary-7d6f8c9d4-9rfm2 1/1     Running   2          12m
```
and
```
curl -s http://metrics.internal/hosts/eu-west-*/kv_cache_evictions | jq . | sort -nr | head
# host eu-west-2-a: 120 evictions/min
# host eu-west-2-b: 98 evictions/min
```

maria_s: fwiw, I see an alert correlation: `model-worker-kv-cache-miss` fired at same time. Could be a regression from the canary. Suggest scale down canary and route traffic back to stable.

emily_prod: customer-impact quick note: search/autocomplete customers on eu-west are seeing ~20-30% increase in latency for queries < 50 tokens. No Pager escalations from CS yet but I'm pinging them.

alex_k: mitigation plan proposal: 1) remove canary routing (rollback canary traffic), 2) scale stable up + warm caches, 3) follow up with postmortem and rollback of tokenization change if confirmed. Anyone object?

cheng_w: +1 for immediate rollback of canary routing. I'll prepare the helm rollback command.

lee_ops: executing routing change now. Will set stable traffic to 100% and cordon canary pods.

lee_ops: (action) `kubectl patch svc embed-service --patch '{"spec":{"selector":{"canary":"false"}}}'` — patched. Confirming traffic shift.

alex_k: confirm seeing request rate drop on canary pods, and p95 starting to decrease from 820ms -> 350ms in last 2 mins. p99 still high but trending down.

pagerduty: Incident INC-6721 acknowledged by alex_k. Next escalation in 15m if no ack change.

oncall-bot: RUNBOOK LINK: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-service-latency (steps followed: rollback canary, scale stable, check kv cache metrics)

maria_s: I'm going to scale stable to 6 replicas to warm caches:
```
kubectl scale deploy embed-service-stable --replicas=6 -n prod
```

alex_k: scaling done. Also bumping `cache_size` on worker config for eu-west to 1.2x to reduce eviction rate temporarily. Applying config patch.

alex_k: patch applied. Waiting for workers to pick up config (rolling restart). p95 now ~320ms, p99 ~900ms and trending down.

emily_prod: CS update: alerting a handful of paying customers in eu-west about degraded performance; offering status updates. No major revenue-impacting errors reported yet.

product-liaison: tagging product and account managers — we'll prepare a short note to customers if p99 doesn't recover within 30m.

cheng_w: logs from canary show repeated `tokenize()` reentrant calls for short inputs; looks like a code-path bug increasing work per request. I'll open a PR to revert that change in upstream repo and mark it for hotfix.

alex_k: good catch. For now mitigations in prod are holding. I'll continue to monitor for 20min window then decide if we can close PD.

lee_ops: handing off active monitoring to maria_s at 10:30 UTC (my shift ends). Leaving notes: canary routing removed, stable scaled to 6, cache_size bumped, follow-up PR to revert tokenization in progress: https://git.internal/r/redwood/embed-service/pulls/489

maria_s: taking over monitoring. I'll keep PD open until p99 < 600ms for 15 consecutive minutes. If it spikes again I'll escalate to SRE manager.

oncall-bot: PD Incident INC-6721 updated: status=mitigated -> monitoring.

alex_k: summary for postmortem: cause: canary tokenization change increased KV cache churn for short prompts; effect: p95/p99 SLO burn in eu-west for short requests; mitigation: rollback routing, scale stable, bump cache size, revert change in codebase. Tickets: INC-6721, PMT-224 (postmortem).

emily_prod: added customer impact note to INC-6721 — approx 12% of eu-west traffic impacted, mostly short-query autocomplete flows.

product-liaison: creating CC list for customer comms draft.

maria_s: p99 now steady ~420ms for 18 minutes. I will close PD in 7 minutes if stable. Leaving handoff note for oncall: watch kv_cache_evictions and canary PR status.

pagerduty: Incident INC-6721 status changed to resolved by maria_s (will archive).

alex_k: thanks everyone. Follow-ups: verify canary CI tests for tokenization, add alert for kv_cache_evictions > 50/min, and add a step in canary rollout to run short-input synthetic workload.

oncall-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: TRE-1024 (add cache eviction alert), TRE-1025 (canary synthetic short-input test), TRE-1026 (revert tokenization change hotfix).

maria_s: closing thread, moving to postmortem doc creation. :white_check_mark:
